name: project-name
description: Full-stack authentication boilerplate with Bun, Express, Angular, and MongoDB

scripts.install:all: bun run install:backend && bun run install:frontend && bun run install:admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:frontend" "bun run dev:admin"
scripts.build: bun run build:frontend && bun run build:admin
scripts.setup: bun install && bun run install:all && echo Setup complete! Run 'bun run dev' to start development servers.
